### 💡 Is your feature request related to a problem?
A clear and concise description of what the problem is. Ex. "I'm frustrated when..."

### 🎯 Proposed Solution
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen. Describe the UI/UX components, ExoPlayer / Media3 configuration changes, AI subtitle enhancements, or additional gesture controls you have in mind.

### 🔄 Alternative Solutions
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or workarounds you've considered.

### 🎨 Additional Context
Add any other context, mockup screenshots, custom shader references, or API designs about the feature request here.
